grammar.pattern: 多大 / 多少 / 几 / 哪 / 哪里 / 哪儿 / 哪些 / 什么 / 谁 / 怎么
grammar.explanation: 多 + adjective asks degree: 多大 asks age or size. 多少 asks amount; 几 asks a number expected to be small and takes a classifier before a noun. 哪 chooses one; 哪些 chooses several. 哪里 and 哪儿 ask place. 什么 asks a thing, 谁 a person, 怎么 a method. Put the question word in the answer’s position.

commonMistakes.why: Use a classifier after 几 before 人 in the ordinary beginner pattern.

grammar.purpose: Ask a follow-up question without an extra question particle
grammar.explanation: Keep ordinary Chinese word order when using a question word: 你去学校 becomes 你去哪里. The question word itself asks for information, so do not add 吗. 谁 can be the subject or object. Several short follow-ups are easier to answer than one long interrogation. Use 请问 with an unfamiliar person.

examples.py: shéi zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu ?
examples.en: Who is at the cinema entrance?

examples.py: qǐng wèn , zhè gè dì diǎn zěn me qù ?
examples.en: Excuse me, how do I get to this location?

commonMistakes.why: A where-question does not take the yes/no particle 吗.

lines.zh: 后天一起看电影吧。
lines.py: hòu tiān yì qǐ kàn diàn yǐng ba .
lines.en: Let us see a film together the day after tomorrow.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 后天是星期天吗？
lines.py: hòu tiān shì xīng qī tiān ma ?
lines.en: Is the day after tomorrow Sunday?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是，星期天。
lines.py: shì , xīng qī tiān .
lines.en: Yes, Sunday.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看什么电影？地点在哪里？
lines.py: kàn shén me diàn yǐng ? dì diǎn zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: What film? Where is the venue?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看一个中国电影，在学校旁边的电影院。
lines.py: kàn yī gè zhōng guó diàn yǐng , zài xué xiào páng biān de diàn yǐng yuàn .
lines.en: A Chinese film, at the cinema next to the school.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 哪些人想去？一共几个人？
lines.py: nǎ xiē rén xiǎng qù ? yī gòng jǐ gè rén ?
lines.en: Which people want to go? How many people altogether?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我和两个朋友，一共三个人。
lines.py: wǒ hé liǎng gè péng you , yī gòng sān gè rén .
lines.en: Me and two friends: three people altogether.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 门票多少钱？谁买票？
lines.py: mén piào duō shao qián ? shéi mǎi piào ?
lines.en: How much are tickets? Who will buy them?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 一张三十块，我买。
lines.py: yī zhāng sān shí kuài , wǒ mǎi .
lines.en: Thirty yuan each. I will buy them.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我们在哪儿见？怎么去？
lines.py: wǒ men zài nǎr jiàn ? zěn me qù ?
lines.en: Where shall we meet? How do we get there?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看地图，我们在电影院门口见。记住，日期是星期天。
lines.py: kàn dì tú , wǒ men zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu jiàn . jì zhù , rì qī shì xīng qī tiān .
lines.en: Check the map. We will meet at the cinema entrance. Remember, the date is Sunday.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。我刚才的日期错了，谢谢你回答。
lines.py: zhī dào le . wǒ gāng cái de rì qī cuò le , xiè xiè nǐ huí dá .
lines.en: Got it. The date I had just now was wrong. Thanks for answering.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why does the last speaker thank the friend?
choices: The friend corrected the date and clarified the plan
questions.answer: The friend corrected the date and clarified the plan

reading.title: The corrected plan
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Use the final message, not the writer’s earlier mistake.

lines.zh: 今天我问朋友：后天去哪儿？
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ wèn péng you : hòu tiān qù nǎr ?
lines.en: Today I ask a friend: where are we going the day after tomorrow?

lines.zh: 他回答：星期天去学校旁边的电影院。
lines.py: tā huí dá : xīng qī tiān qù xué xiào páng biān de diàn yǐng yuàn .
lines.en: He answers: on Sunday we are going to the cinema next to the school.

lines.zh: 我看地图，记住了地点。
lines.py: wǒ kàn dì tú , jì zhù le dì diǎn .
lines.en: I look at the map and remember the location.

lines.zh: 我们在电影院门口见，一共三个人。
lines.py: wǒ men zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu jiàn , yī gòng sān gè rén .
lines.en: We will meet at the cinema entrance; there are three people altogether.

lines.zh: 我问哪些朋友去，他说是我认识的两个学生。
lines.py: wǒ wèn nǎ xiē péng you qù , tā shuō shì wǒ rèn shi de liǎng gè xué sheng .
lines.en: I ask which friends are going; he says two students I know.

lines.zh: 门票一张三十块，他买票。
lines.py: mén piào yī zhāng sān shí kuài , tā mǎi piào .
lines.en: Admission tickets are thirty yuan each; he is buying them.

lines.zh: 我还问看什么电影，他说是中国电影。
lines.py: wǒ hái wèn kàn shén me diàn yǐng , tā shuō shì zhōng guó diàn yǐng .
lines.en: I also ask what film we are seeing; he says it is a Chinese film.

lines.zh: 我刚才的日期错了，现在知道是星期天。
lines.py: wǒ gāng cái de rì qī cuò le , xiàn zài zhī dào shì xīng qī tiān .
lines.en: The date I had just now was wrong; now I know it is Sunday.

choices: Go to a film on Sunday
